questions: What is the recommended way to dump settings in starlette.config without exposing sensitive information like JWT secrets?
What is the latest stable Python release today?
cost_note: Two fixed questions; no manual HTTP retries or SDK retries; at most two embedding calls and two generation calls. Each final system/user prompt is tokenizer-counted including JSON, metadata, role text and a conservative 512-token framing reserve, bounded to 12000; each generation output bounded to 512. No tool messages or images. All input charged at uncached standard rate. Both requests may generate; cutoff refusal is not assumed.
conditional_note: The <=12000 bound is now enforced in local API code. Requires deploying and verifying these settings before any smoke test. It is not a account-wide or future-traffic dollar budget.
existing_resources_updated_on_future_app: ECR github-rag-api: one additional image, retain existing images
Lambda github-rag-api: code image reference; optionally explicit environment values for only the two new controls, preserving all other keys
deployment_requirements: On separate explicit approval only: build/push one image to existing us-east-2 ECR, update existing Lambda code, preserve all other settings/resources/images; verify effective RAG_MAX_GENERATION_INPUT_TOKENS=12000, OPENAI_GENERATION_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=512 and OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES=0. Abort if overrides differ. Exact two questions/top_k=5; no HTTP retry. No deployment or API calls now.
measured_latency_status: Existing local and health-only live results are historical, from code before these new controls. No latency/quality claim for capped code.
